_note: movement = one row per movement system; hooks = every place the mod touches the game; probes = the go/no-go tests that decide whether a movement row can be built. 'refs' must resolve to a row id in weapons.json or movement. 'needs_probe' on a movement row must resolve to a probes row. null = unfilled cell; a probe's 'result' stays null until run in the real game. Scope decision (user): v0.1 = gunplay + lean + sprint; if the sprint probe fails, ship lean + gunplay only.
